_note: Cross-field vocabulary: one line per term, footnoted by render.py at its first use in the body. A general vocabulary for readers from adjacent fields; never per gene. `pattern` is a case-sensitive regular expression matched on word boundaries.

terms.text: Loss-of-function observed/expected upper bound fraction (gnomAD): how depleted the gene is of predicted loss-of-function variants in the population; lower means more depleted.
Probability of loss-of-function intolerance (gnomAD), an older constraint score; close to 1 means pLoF variants are depleted.
Predicted loss of function: stop-gained, frameshift and essential splice-site variants.
Missense Z-score (gnomAD): depletion of missense variants against expectation; ≥ 3.09 is significant constraint.
Pathogenic / likely pathogenic, a ClinVar classification for a named condition; stars (★) give its review status, from one submitter (1★) to an expert panel (3★) or practice guideline (4★).
Gain of function / loss of function: whether a variant increases or decreases the protein's activity or amount.
Transcripts per million: RNA abundance normalised for gene length and sequencing depth (GTEx).
Normalised TPM (Human Protein Atlas): TPM normalised across samples so tissues and cell types can be compared.
Normalised counts per million (Human Protein Atlas single-cell data), summed per cell type.
Genome-wide association study: tests common variants across the genome for association with a trait; a hit marks a region, not necessarily this gene.
The variants that together most likely contain the causal variant of a GWAS signal (fine-mapping).
Posterior probability that a GWAS signal and a molecular QTL share one causal variant (coloc); ≥ 0.8 is usually read as shared.
Expression / protein quantitative trait locus: a variant associated with the gene's RNA or protein level.
Open Targets locus-to-gene score: a model's probability that this gene is the causal gene at a GWAS locus.
AlphaFold's per-residue confidence (0–100); below 50 usually marks disordered regions.
DepMap's CRISPR gene-effect score; ≤ −0.5 is DepMap's per-line dependency threshold, −1 the median of common essential genes.
Medical Subject Headings: NLM's controlled vocabulary for indexing PubMed papers; a major heading marks a main topic of the paper.
A gene-level rare-variant test that combines a burden test (variants act in one direction) with a variance test (directions may differ).
Cumulative allele frequency: the summed frequency of the variants in a gene's mask; it can exceed 1 when a mask holds common variants.
NCBI's text-mining service that tags genes, variants, diseases, chemicals and species in PubMed abstracts with database identifiers.
